findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "ask" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: precheck, can_agent_checkout, ask_arc, google_checkout_readiness, dataset_info, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store, validate_ucp_profile · Public sink: submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store · Destructive: submit_leaderboard_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: precheck, can_agent_checkout, ask_arc, google_checkout_readiness, dataset_info, submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store, validate_ucp_profile · Public sink: submit_leaderboard_run, submit_store · Destructive: submit_leaderboard_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
